Cinematic photoreal shot, 16:9. The shot starts as a waist-up medium two-shot of Thomas Edison (Image 1) on the left and Nikola Tesla (Image 2) on the right standing side by side on the stage, both facing the camera, both spreading their arms wide to the roaring crowd, mouths closed, Tesla with a calm victorious smile and Edison with a grudging one. During the last second the camera smoothly decelerates and settles into a stationary shot.
